title: Halden migration checkpoint
contextText: Checkpoint after the first dry run.

segments.text: Okay, checkpoint on the migration. JD, can you start with the dry run?
Sure. We ran the full dry run on Monday. 98 percent of carrier records migrated cleanly on the first pass.
The two percent that failed are mostly carriers with duplicate depot codes. That's a data problem on our side, not the scripts.
Can we clean those before the real cutover?
Yes, I'll get my team to deduplicate them next week.
There's one bug on our side though. Delivery windows are shifting by an hour for the southern depots. It's a timezone conversion issue.
How long to fix?
I'll fix the timezone bug by Wednesday and rerun that slice.
Good. Sasha, where are we on the contract side?
The data processing addendum is with our legal team. I'll get legal to approve the data processing addendum by March 6.
Is there anything in it you expect them to push back on?
Only the sub-processor list. Legal always asks about sub-processors.
We'll send an updated list today so they have it.
On sequencing, I'd like to propose we cut over region by region, starting with the northern depots.
Why northern first?
Smallest volume, and the depot managers there are the most patient with us.
From a technical side that's fine, the scripts are already region-aware.
Any objection? Then we cut over region by region, starting with the northern depots.
No objection.
One personal thing, sorry. I've got a court hearing on my divorce next month, so I may be slow to reply for a couple of days around then.
Of course, Rafferty, thanks for the heads-up. We'll route anything urgent through JD.
Happy to cover.
Also, when you send the sub-processor list, send it to me, not to Maddox. I'll forward it to legal.
Will do. So: legal by March 6, timezone fix by Wednesday, northern depots first.

note.body:
# Halden migration checkpoint

**Date:** February 26
**Attendees:** Alma Mockwell (Larkspur Labs), JD (Larkspur Labs), Sasha (Halden Freight procurement), Rafferty Fixture (Halden Freight)

## Summary

Checkpoint on the Halden route optimizer migration after the first full dry run.

## Dry run results

- 98 percent of carrier records migrated cleanly on the first pass.
- The 2 percent that failed are mostly carriers with duplicate depot codes, a data issue on Halden's side; Rafferty's team will deduplicate them next week.
- A timezone conversion bug shifts delivery windows by an hour for the southern depots.

## Decisions

- Cutover will happen **region by region, starting with the northern depots**, which have the smallest volume and the most patient depot managers. The scripts are already region-aware.

## Contract

The data processing addendum is with Halden's legal team. Sasha expects questions only about the sub-processor list, which Larkspur will send today — to Sasha, not Maddox.

## Action items

- **Sasha (procurement)** — get legal to approve the data processing addendum by March 6.
- **JD** — fix the timezone bug by Wednesday and rerun the southern slice.
- **Rafferty Fixture** — have his team deduplicate the carrier depot codes next week.
- **Alma Mockwell** — send the updated sub-processor list to Sasha today.

## Notes

- Rafferty may be slow to reply for a couple of days next month for personal reasons; urgent items go through JD.
